summary: Clarivate Plc filed an 8-K/A on October 13, 2026, providing unaudited pro forma condensed consolidated financials (balance sheet as of June 30, 2026; statements of operations for six months ended June 30, 2026 and years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, 2023) following completion of its sale of the Life Sciences & Healthcare business to an affiliate of Altaris, LLC. The July 3, 2026 Stock and Asset Purchase Agreement provided an aggregate purchase price of $600 million: approximately $500 million cash at closing, a $75 million unsecured senior note, and $25 million deferred cash consideration payable upon the later of TSA completion and January 31, 2028. At the October 6, 2026 close, Clarivate received approximately $488.4 million in net cash after closing costs and working capital adjustments. The sale represents a strategic shift in the business and met discontinued operations requirements. Watch pro forma leverage reduction, the $75 million note's credit risk and collection timeline, deferred consideration tied to TSA completion, and residual core-segment execution risk post-divestiture.
